# nds_rom_tool

[← Command index](README.md)

Decrypt or encrypt Nintendo DS ROMs in place with NDecrypt.

## Synopsis

```
nds_rom_tool [options]
```

## Description

Finds every `.nds` file under the input path (or takes the one file given) and runs
NDecrypt on it: `-d` decrypts the secure area, `-e` encrypts it again. NDecrypt
rewrites each file in place, so no new files are created unless `-g` is given, which
has NDecrypt write the file's size and hashes to a companion file.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | An `.nds` file, or a directory searched recursively for them; must exist. |
| `-d, --decrypt` | Decrypt each ROM in place. |
| `-e, --encrypt` | Encrypt each ROM in place. |
| `-g, --generate_hash` | Also have NDecrypt write the ROM's size and hashes to a companion file. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Decrypt every DS ROM in a folder

```bash
nds_rom_tool -i /path/to/nds -d
```

### Preview the decryption without changing anything

```bash
nds_rom_tool -i /path/to/nds -d -p -v
```

### Encrypt one ROM and record its hashes

```bash
nds_rom_tool -i "/path/to/Game (USA).nds" -e -g
```

## Notes

- Without `-d` or `-e` nothing is done. If both are given, `-d` wins.
- NDecrypt must be installed as a JoyBox tool.
